summary: Bulgaria's statistics institute publishes convicted persons by citizenship for each offence, including lewd acts against children, crimes against youth and trafficking, and child victims by age and sex without citizenship. Roma and Turkish identity are recorded only in the census, never in crime or child-protection data.

nations.National (NSI, Interior Ministry, anti-t: Annual court-based crime statistics; child victim tables.

european_title: Not recorded by any Bulgarian crime source
european_note: Bulgarian crime statistics separate only Bulgarian from other citizenship. The census asks about ethnic group (Bulgarian, Turkish, Roma and others), but no crime, victim or child-protection statistic records it, so neither European descent nor Roma identity can be measured for child harm.
proxy_note: Bulgaria records citizenship only in crime data, never ethnicity. Every group below is a proxy, not ethnicity.

harms.label: Lewd acts (Art. 149-150) and rape
harms.intro: 73 people were convicted of lewd acts (Art. 149-150; Art. 149 concerns children under 14) in 2025: 70 Bulgarian citizens and 3 of other citizenship. Of 35 convicted of rape, 34 were Bulgarian and 1 a dual citizen. NSI counted 68 child victims of lewd acts in 2024, with no citizenship.

victims.text: NSI publishes child victims (8-17) of each offence by age and sex, but no citizenship or ethnicity.

perpetrators.scope: Bulgaria, persons convicted of lewd acts (Art. 149-150), 2025
perpetrators.share_note: NSI 'Crimes and persons convicted 2025', table 11: persons convicted with a final sentence in 2025 by citizenship (Bulgarian; Bulgarian and other; other; stateless). All victim ages. Citizenship, a proxy, not ethnicity: 'other' is foreign or stateless citizenship; Bulgarian citizens (incl. dual Bulgarian and other) include Roma, Turks and every other ethnic group.

cross.text: Victims have no citizenship, so nothing can be linked.

breakdown.why: NSI 'Crimes and persons convicted 2025' (table 11) gives convicted persons by citizenship: lewd acts (Art. 149-150, mostly against children) 73 convicted, 70 Bulgarian and 3 other; rape 35 (1 dual citizen). NSI child victims (1,215 in 2024) have age and sex but no citizenship.

Bodily harm: 923 convicted (10 other citizenship, 4 dual), all victim ages; crimes against youth (Art. 187-193): 142 convicted, all Bulgarian. 294 child victims of bodily harm (2024) have no citizenship.
Crimes against youth (Art. 187-193, incl. leaving a child without care): 142 convicted, all Bulgarian citizens. Child-protection reports (SACP) give age and sex but no citizenship or ethnicity.
Completed murder: 49 convicted (2 other citizenship), all victim ages. No victims by citizenship.
Trafficking (Art. 159a-159d): 29 convicted, all Bulgarian. The National Commission reported 89 victims in 2025 (34 third-country nationals), with no child-by-citizenship split.
Pornography offences sit in the depravity chapter (215 convicted, 5 other citizenship, 1 dual). NSI counts 7 child victims of child pornography (2024), with no citizenship.

components.name: Victim heritage
components.full: Official data by harm that separately identify children of European descent (e.g. White non-Hispanic, White British) alongside every other group, self-reported or official, few unknowns. Broad categories that lump European-descent people with others get partial credit; proxies (nationality, citizenship, migration background, country of birth) at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Perpetrator heritage
components.full: Same standard for perpetrators: not perceived, few unknowns, European descent separately identified. Proxies at most 9.4 points.

components.name: Coverage and missing data
components.full: Over 90% of the population covered, under 10% unknown

components.name: Rates and linkage
components.full: Rates per 100,000 possible, and victim heritage linked to perpetrator heritage

score.gold_standard: 100% means a country publishes data that separately identifies people of European descent, both as perpetrators (so one can tell when they disproportionately harm a group) and as child victims (so one can tell when European-descent children are disproportionately harmed), alongside every other group, linked victim to perpetrator, for every harm.
score.rules: Heritage is 75 of every 100 points (victims 37.5, perpetrators 37.5); coverage, rates and access share the other 25. Proxies such as nationality or migration background earn at most a quarter of the heritage points. A country with no real ethnicity data for victims or perpetrators is capped at 25%.
score.why: Bulgaria scores 11% on the stricter scale (0-20%). NSI publishes convicted persons by citizenship for each offence, including lewd acts against children and trafficking, and child victims by age without citizenship. Roma and other ethnic groups are recorded only in the census, never in crime data.
score.weights_id: harm weights of 19 Nov 2026 (homicide 25, sexual abuse 20, sex trafficking 20, physical abuse 15, online exploitation 10, neglect 10)

nsi.records: 21,187 convicted persons by offence, sex, age and citizenship (1,774 other or stateless).
nsi.limitations: Citizenship only; convictions only; all victim ages.

nsiv.name: Малолетни и непълнолетни лица, пострадали от престъпления (Minors and juveniles injured by crimes)
nsiv.records: 1,215 child victims (8-17) in finally decided cases by offence, age, sex and region.
nsiv.limitations: No citizenship or ethnicity; 2025 table not yet published.

ncct.limitations: Press figures only; no child-by-citizenship split.

mvr.name: Доклад за дейността на МВР през 2025 г.

availability_note: Each harm has an 'availability' map listing the victim and perpetrator groups with any published figure (overall and by measure) and any linked victim-perpetrator pairs. Groups not listed have no data for that harm; the explorer should grey them out rather than offer an empty combination.
